title: Title & Registration Services Lien Corrections: Start of the Lien Wait
content:
For lien charges on a Title & Registration Services order returned for a lien information error, the lien wait starts on the order's most recent submission date when an outside lender's proceeds were posted to the purchase order, because the lender's lien was on record when that packet went to the state; it starts on the date of the order's most recent lien information error return when Kestrel Auto Finance proceeds were posted and no outside lender's proceeds were, because the faulty lien data came from Kestrel's own finance records and the wait before the return is Kestrel's; otherwise, when no lender's proceeds were posted, it starts on the order's opening date.

## Records read

- the payment entries on the purchase order ledger under Vehicle Purchase Agreements, by source of funds (outside lender proceeds, Kestrel finance proceeds);
- the title order's most recent submission date and opening date;
- the latest state rejection entry on the title order whose reason is lien information error.

| Outside lender proceeds posted | Kestrel Auto Finance proceeds posted | Lien wait starts on |
|---|---|---|
| yes | either | the order's most recent submission date |
| no | yes | the date of the most recent lien information error return |
| no | no | the order's opening date |

## Hypothetical illustrations (opened 3 January, most recent submission 20 January, lien information error return 2 February)

- Outside lender proceeds on the purchase order: the wait starts 20 January.
- Kestrel finance proceeds only: the wait starts 2 February.
- Paid entirely from the buyer's own funds: the wait starts 3 January.
